description: You produce music and edit video as a hobby, working long sessions late at night after your family is asleep. You've been frustrated by sluggish keyboard response in your DAW and by distracting UI animations when you switch between apps. You also want hot corners so you can instantly show the desktop (to hide your workspace) or jump to Mission Control (to switch projects) with a single mouse flick to a corner. Open System Settings and make all of these changes: (1) enable Reduce Motion under Accessibility > Display so animations don't distract you, (2) set Key Repeat to the fastest possible rate in Keyboard settings, (3) set Delay Until Repeat to the shortest possible delay in Keyboard settings, (4) set the bottom-left hot corner to Show Desktop, and (5) set the top-right hot corner to Mission Control. Hot corners are configured in Desktop & Dock settings. All five changes must persist — the verifier reads NSGlobalDomain and com.apple.dock.

metadata.scenario: hobby/creative — musician optimizing Mac for late-night focused creative sessions
